findingClass: An ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT document that the extractor downloaded and read but that published ZERO anchor_investors rows - the document sits in extraction_status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW' with a zero_rows or reconciliation-refusal error while the IPO's page shows no anchor book at all (#437). The class is a YIELD gap, not a crash: nothing fails, nothing pages, and the IPO simply renders without the anchor table that the letter on file contains.
failThreshold: For every IPO with at least one ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT document whose extraction_status is 'MANUAL_REVIEW': FAIL when the count of anchor_investors rows for that IPO is 0. Reported per IPO by name and slug with the document id and the stored extraction_error - never as a bare count (signal-ownership.md R1).
unverifiableWhen: The IPO has no ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT document at all (nothing was downloaded, so there is nothing to have yielded), or the document is still in PENDING / IN_PROGRESS (the extractor has not finished with it and a zero yield is not yet a verdict).
note: SPEC ONLY - this check is NOT implemented. It has no record('anchor_report_yield') call in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs, so it stays in notCoveredByThisManifest rather than being counted as floor coverage; counting it would read as wider coverage than the floor actually has (scripts/tests/audit-detection-floor.test.mjs case 79). Why it is owed: #437 slices 1 and 2 each fixed a mechanism that turned scanned anchor letters into zero published rows (the table geometry, then the scanner's separator damage), and in BOTH cases the only reason anyone knew was a human reading a MANUAL_REVIEW queue. No nightly signal exists that says 'this IPO has an anchor letter on file and publishes no anchor investors', so the next member of the class will again be found by hand, weeks late. Slice 2 deliberately did not implement it: merging an audit check without a real-data run against staging is the exact failure the defect-fix contract names (an audit check merged unrun crashed the nightly audit for three nights), and this task was barred from every live database.
owner: UNASSIGNED - owed to #437 slice 3. Promotion out of notCoveredByThisManifest requires: a record('anchor_report_yield') call in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs, one run against ipodhan_staging through the tunnel, and the first failing set resolved to IPO identities (expected to be the 16 staging / 18 prod MANUAL_REVIEW documents this check is specified from).
